name: com.romai.mcp.tools
description: Custom Editor MCP tools for IvanMurzak Unity-MCP. Adds 16 tools across three domains: UI Toolkit (link stylesheet, attach UIDocument, create PanelSettings), Build (platform get/set, scenes list/set, settings get/set, execute), Profiler (start/stop/status, frame timing, counters). Designed to fill the gaps left by the upstream MCP server.
